text:
maria.g: Heads-up — found plaintext S3 creds in a vault-proxy cache dump on staging. Looks like an old backup service account got serialized into /var/log/vault-proxy/cache_dump.json after a SIGUSR1 trigger. Pinging @samir @nick_o for rotation/impact.

samir: Ack. Can you paste the redacted lines and which pod?

maria.g: Log snippet (redacted):
```
{"timestamp":"2026-03-23T14:12:07Z","cache_state":{"backup_bot":{"s3_access_key":"AKIA***REDACTED***","s3_secret":"***REDACTED***","bucket":"redwood-staging-backups"}}}
```
Pod: staging-proxy-7f9b (ns=staging-cache). I grepped for other dumps and saw same pattern at 14:11-14:13Z.

nick_o: If it's in pod logs it's likely a legacy backup job. Immediate plan: 1) Suspend backups, 2) Create new AWS keys for backup-bot, 3) Update Vault secret and rotate consumers, 4) Revoke old keys in AWS, 5) Harden RBAC for proxy SA. Who can open the ticket and run AWS key rotation?

jen: I'll open SEC ticket and start orchestration. Will also enable vault-proxy audit logging for unwrapping events (short window) and stream to secure audit bucket. @sec-bot can you run a quick namespace scan?

sec-bot: sec-bot: Scheduled quick scan for namespace staging-cache. Inspecting 4 pods for cached dumps and env leaks. ETA ~2m.

samir: Do we have KMS envelope usage here? If secrets were wrapped with our KMS key, we can rewrap; if plaintext was logged, rotate at provider (AWS IAM). I'll coordinate key rewrap with infra. Also need to remove that SIGUSR1 handler in staging config — looks like a backport.

maria.g: Confirmed — dump triggered by a debug handler that calls `cache.DumpState()` on SIGUSR1. We removed that in prod but a developer backported it to staging. Pushing a patch to remove the handler now.

nick_o: Rotation commands (AWS):
```
# create new key
aws iam create-access-key --user backup-bot
# update Vault secret (example)
vault kv put secret/staging/backup-bot access_key=AKIA... secret_key=...
# delete old key after verified
aws iam delete-access-key --access-key-id OLDKEYID --user backup-bot
```
Also make sure vault-proxy reads secret via versioned path, not plaintext env.

jen: Adding policy changes: backup-bot currently has `s3:*`. I'll PR to narrow to `s3:GetObject, s3:PutObject` scoped to `arn:aws:s3:::redwood-staging-backups/*`. Assigning PR to @samir for review.

samir: RBAC change: the `staging-proxy-bot` clusterrolebinding has `storage-admin` privileges. Plan: replace with a namespace-scoped Role with limited verbs on bucket secrets. After rotation, we'll remove that cluster role binding. @nick_o please run `kubectl auth can-i` smoke checks post-change.

sec-bot: sec-bot: Scan results (quick): Found 1 cache_dump.json file containing tokens in staging-proxy-7f9b. No other pods with matching patterns. CVE scan of proxy image returned no criticals.

maria.g: I quarantined the offending log object in GCS and alerted the partner team whose backups might be affected. No outbound transfers in logs besides the scheduled job.

nick_o: I'll perform the canary rotation in test: create new AWS keys, update `secret/test/backup-bot`, restart test backup job, validate writes to test bucket. If green, we'll do staging. Estimated 30-45m.

jen: Ticket created: SEC-1427. Steps and owners listed (rotation: nick_o, policy PR: jen, RBAC: samir, code patch: maria.g). Will update with timestamps.

samir: After rotation, rewrap the KMS key and set automated rotation every 30 days. Also enable 90-day retention for vault-proxy audit logs and make unwrapping events an alert condition.

maria.g: Deployed patch to remove SIGUSR1 dump in staging; restarted proxy pod.

nick_o: Backup job validated in test. Proceeding to rotate staging keys now. Creating new access key and updating Vault secret.

jen: PR for Vault policy change: opened and linked in SEC-1427, requesting @samir review. Also adding an ops step to enable `vault audit` to file path and ensure logshipper only ships redacted lines.

samir: After keys are rotated and old keys deleted, let's run a full audit of other namespaces that might have the old secret. Use `rg 'AKIA' -n /var/log/*` across cluster images and ask image builders to run secret-scan on CI.

sec-bot: sec-bot: Added CI secret-scan hook template to infra repo and created an alert rule to detect `AKIA` patterns in logs.

maria.g: Rotation complete. New keys live, old keys deleted in AWS. Vault secret at `secret/staging/backup-bot` updated and vault-proxy restarted to pick up the new version. Ran backup job and verified objects in bucket. PR for code change merged.

samir: Great. RBAC change applied at 15:40Z — replaced clusterrolebinding with a namespace role with limited verbs. Audit logs for unwrapping enabled and forwarded to secure bucket.

jen: I'll draft a blameless postmortem and timeline; will include remediation (remove debug handlers from staging/dev branches, CI secret-scan, RBAC tightening, 30d rotation). Owning postmortem: assigned to jen.

sec-bot: sec-bot: Final scan complete, no other exposures found. Locking thread if no objections. :lock: 

nick_o: :thumbsup: Thanks everyone — good catch and fast coordination.

jen: Closing SEC-1427 after 24h observation window unless any anomalies show up.

maria.g: Filing short follow-up doc with action items and links to PRs/ticket.
